charts.name: Pla de comptes de referència d’Andorra
charts.legal_reference: Llei 30/2007 and the Pla general de comptabilitat approved by Decret 479/2025 prescribe the annual accounts (a balance sheet and an income statement, in a normal and an abridged model) and the recognition and valuation rules, but the text read prints no numbered chart of accounts: the account plan of this pack is original. Four digits, grouped like the plan the Andorran profession has long used (1 equity and long-term funds, 2 non-current assets, 3 stocks, 4 third parties and the IGI accounts, 5 financial accounts, 6 expenses, 7 income), with the names of the Pla general de comptabilitat’s headings.

numbering.legal_reference: The texts read do not say how an Andorran invoice is numbered: the invoicing regulation that Llei 11/2012 refers to for the content of the invoice was not found. `sequential` and the number format are conventions of this pack and not rules of the law.

tax_point.legal_reference: Llei 11/2012 has its own chapter on the accrual (meritació) of the tax; it was not read article by article, and `invoice_date` is a convention of this pack. A payment received before the invoice may bring the accrual forward.

einvoicing.legal_reference: No structured e-invoice standard or clearance system of the Andorran administration was found in the texts read; e-tràmits takes the declarations, not invoices. `obligation` is `none` for want of a text, not on a finding that none exists.

not_taxed.legal_reference: The text of Llei 11/2012 and of Llei 10/2014 read contains no article making the buyer in Andorra assess the IGI on a service bought from a supplier established abroad: the chapters on the taxable person and on the place of supply were searched for a reverse charge and none was found. This is a finding about the texts read, not about the whole of the Andorran legislation; if a rule exists elsewhere it is a gap recorded in the README.
